scope: Qualification-only complete PREP_SLID1/2/KEEPF and original phase membership blocks; local rows only.
boundary_substitutions: USE TRI7BOX to USE LIFECYCLE_FOREIGN only
private constants/module and process COMMON names; ISO_C_BINDING binary64/C int boundary
allocation adapters preserve original temporary integer arrays; no numerical source translation

membership.outputs: one-based complete INDEX snapshot and count; API-zero unused tail

prepare1.counts: NSN, NRTM, NADMSR, retained occurrence count
prepare1.arrays: native column-major IRECT(4,NRTM), ADMSR(4,NRTM), IRTLM(4,NSN), TIME_S(2,NSN), complete FARM/PENM/LBM/LCM(4,count), ISLIDE(4,NSN)

expand.counts: NSN, NRTM, NADMSR, capacity, normal-incidence length, removal-incidence length
expand.offsets: native zero-based prefix offsets; entries/native references remain one-based
expand.outputs: complete K_STOK count; native I_STOK and appended arrays change only when full append fits

keep.counts: NSN, NRTM, occurrence count, positive index count, node-map length
keep.arrays: actual CAND_N/E, INDEX, native global main and node identities, complete IRTLM/PENM/PENE_OLD/SECND_FR/TIME_S/STIF_OLD
keep.outputs: native signed occurrence markers and source row clearing; unchanged history fields retained
